basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and winemaking enthusiast from Las Vegas, NV. I spend my days working as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobbies. A huge fan of Jurassic Park and a devoted follower of the Bates family. I usually browse Reddit during the evening hours, often while sipping on a glass of my latest homebrew wine. In a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for Pokemon Go.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in graphic design through online courses and YouTube tutorials. Developed a keen interest in winemaking over the past few years, learning from community forums and local workshops. My experience in gaming spans decades, with a particular focus on mobile AR games.
